name: GM Mobility Reimbursement Program
description: Up to $1,500 reimbursement for adaptive equipment on new Chevrolet vehicles
fullDescription: General Motors offers reimbursement for eligible adaptive equipment installed on new vehicles. The Chevrolet Mobility Program offers up to $1,500 plus 1 year of OnStar One.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $1,500 reimbursement for eligible adaptive equipment on new Chevrolet vehicles
- 1 year of OnStar One (Stolen Vehicle Assistance, 24/7 Emergency Advisors, Wi-Fi Hotspot)
- Covers equipment like hand controls and wheelchair lifts
- Available on new vehicle purchase or lease
- Buick, GMC, and Cadillac have similar programs (check with your dealer for amounts)
howToGetIt:
1. Purchase or lease a new eligible GM vehicle
2. Have adaptive equipment installed by a qualified installer
3. Download and complete the reimbursement application from the Chevrolet accessibility page
4. Submit receipts and documentation by the deadline on the application
keywords: GM, Chevrolet, Buick, Cadillac, GMC, mobility, adaptive equipment, disability, reimbursement
